video_title: Break the ice (5 ảnh nhập sẵn)

scenes.visual_description: Max alone against a plain light grey background, shoulders squared.
scenes.character_action: Max closes his eyes for a moment, then gives one small nod.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Max: "Right. I will just say hello."
scenes.subtitle: Right. I will just say hello.

scenes.visual_description: A plain shot of Max from the shoulders up, mouth closed, eyes flicking sideways.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.

scenes.visual_description: Max looks down at his cup, then up again. Plain background.
scenes.character_action: Max turns the cup once in his hands.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.subtitle: The cup is very interesting.

scenes.visual_description: Max stands against a plain warm background and grins.
scenes.character_action: Max raises one hand in a small wave.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.subtitle: Nice cup.

scenes.visual_description: Max laughs, shoulders dropping. Plain background, nobody else in shot.
scenes.camera: Locked static medium shot, no camera movement.
scenes.dialogue: Max: "Break the ice means to start a conversation."
scenes.subtitle: Break the ice = start a conversation.
